llm_fields.description: The scheme provides a steel-made kiosk and a tool kit free of cost to roadside cobblers engaged in repair work or footwear production, promoting self‑employment.
llm_fields.eligibility: Applicants must be leather artisans belonging to specified sub‑castes of the Scheduled Castes, be at least 18 years old, have an annual family income not exceeding ₹30,000 in rural areas or ₹25,000 in urban areas, must not have received benefits from other schemes (except training programmes), and their family members must not be employed in government or semi‑government organisations.
